resolutionDefinition: These forecast official public reporting, not the unobserved administrative event. YES requires a dated press release in this board and its attachment explicitly reporting the specified milestone by the deadline. A plan or announcement of an intention is not enough. If the board and required archive pages are fully accessible and none qualifies, resolve NO. If coverage is inaccessible or incomplete, remain unresolved; never treat an outage as NO. Record a retrieval snapshot and quote locator before scoring.

cards.event: The agency publicly reports an actual architectural-review result for Hyundai's Saemangeum AIDC by 2026-10-31 23:59 Asia/Seoul, irrespective of whether it approves or requires revision.
cards.probabilityBasis: Uncalibrated subjective judgment: the release explicitly schedules October results, but no historical on-time reporting reference class was obtained.
cards.support: Page 2 schedules written review and October results.
cards.counterEvidence: A review can be delayed or not publicly reported. No completed result is asserted.

cards.event: The agency publicly reports an issued building permit for the same AIDC by 2026-12-31 23:59 Asia/Seoul.
cards.probabilityBasis: Uncalibrated subjective judgment: the agency targets year-end permission, but review and follow-on procedures create additional dependencies. No empirical frequency is claimed.
cards.support: Page 2 states an intention to complete the building permit within the year.
cards.counterEvidence: Review revisions and follow-on procedures may delay permission; stated intent is not an issued permit.

dependence: Two events concern the same project and are correlated. They are not two independent tests of forecasting skill.
scoring: After resolution: Brier=(probability-outcome)^2, outcome in {0,1}. Keep original cards immutable; record resolution in a new dated artifact. Inspect on 2026-11-01 and 2027-01-01 respectively. Until publicly deployed these are drafted, not publicly preregistered.

summary.zh: 两项新万金AIDC官方公开报道预测，区分审议结果与许可；概率为未校准主观判断，经验基准率缺失。
summary.en: Two forecasts of official AIDC milestone reporting distinguish review results from permits; probabilities are uncalibrated judgments with no empirical base rate.
